dct_description_sm: This project is part of the Canadian IPY 2007-2009 project Seabirds as indicators of climate change.  Adult murre stomach contents were quantified to compare with other dietary studies on Coats Island, and murre diets in other locations. A number of body metrics were also recorded and several tissue samples have been entered into the National Specimen bank for each bird.
dct_title_s: Seabird diet as an indicator of change in the marine environment at Coats Island
